messages:
Evan: FYI - BlueCart wants a 1-week POC. Goals: live streaming order summaries, strict JSON output for ETL, demo a function/tool call to their product-catalog API, and turnaround on security questionnaire (mTLS + BYOK ask). Can SE/Infra confirm patterns and a quick hosted vs dedicated cost delta?
Ritika: All doable. Streaming + function calls supported by SDKs (SSE/ws). For strict JSON recommend using function-call schema with a post-emit validator in the demo app. Need QPS and avg token size to size cost.
Evan: They expect sporadic bursts up to 60 QPS, avg 140 tokens, demo window 5h/day. They want in-stream tool results (no external webhooks) to avoid firewall issues.
Jon: Good plan 1 For resumable streams we support resume tokens. Typical flow: initial stream -> server emits resume_token header -> client reconnects sending x-resume-token. Quick WS example:```js
// reopen with resume token
ws = new WebSocket(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TK}`, 'x-resume-token': lastToken } });
ws.onmessage = e => handleChunk(JSON.parse(e.data));
```
Also if ordering matters attach seq_id per chunk.
Ritika: For tool-calls over stream: SDK surfaces tool.call events. Sequence: partial chunks -> tool.call event -> SDK emits tool.result event -> finalize. Demo app should merge tool.result into final JSON and run schema validation.
Camila: Trust notes: Hosted uses our KMS; BYOK requires Private deployment + legal DPA and infra setup. SOC2 summary is available; full pack via trust@redwood.ai. mTLS can be enabled on demo gateway but Ops needs a 30-60min window to upload certs. Also confirm EU data residency if they asked.
Evan: They do want EU residency and mTLS for POC. Also asked if Redwood can sign a standard DPA within their timelines.
Camila: We can sign DPA. EU residency: we can host in eu-west-1. BYOK -> Private + 4-6 week lead time.
Ritika: Ballpark calc for demo day tokens: 60 * 3600 * 5 * 140 = ~181.4M tokens/day at peak bursts. Hosted is simplest for short POC; estimate $250-600/day depending on model. Dedicated is cheaper long-term but needs monthly commit and procurement. I'll make a 1-pager with model options.
Evan: Any enterprise blockers to surface in SOW?
Jon: Blockers: mTLS provisioning window, BYOK lead time if they need keys, webhook reachability (they want in-stream to avoid it), and if they require on-prem/private runtime it'll add weeks. Also network egress rules if tool calls were to hit internal APIs.
Camila: Add legal blockers: DPA/DP processing for EU, and if they want per-tenant HSM evidence that'll escalate to legal & infra.
Ritika: Action items:
- Ritika -> 1-page cost + hosted vs dedicated comparison with model tradeoffs (ETA: today EOD)
- Jon -> sample repo link with resume + in-stream tool handler + small validation shim (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Camila -> SOC2 summary, DPA template, cert rotation template, confirm ops window for mTLS (ETA: EOD)
- Evan -> confirm POC dates and share BlueCart network contact + whether they prefer in-stream or webhook delivery (ETA: EOD)
reserve-bot: [info] tentative capacity reservation requested for 2026-06-17 13:00 UTC for "bluecart-poc".
Evan: I'll ask BlueCart to provide a sanitized dataset and preferred JSON schema for order objects.
Ritika: I'll include a small client-side validator that rejects nonconforming JSON and logs trace ids so demo stays reliable.
Evan: Thanks team 44d moving to SOW draft.
